messages:
sarah: Hey team — customer XYZ (acct xyz-914) reporting sudden p99 spike on /v1/toolcall over the last 30m. p95 ~120ms (ok) but p99 jumped to ~3.2s. Started after a deploy ~40m ago. Request pattern: structured output + JSON schema validation + external tool router.

maria: Thanks Sarah. Can you paste a sample request and the error/trace from logs?

sarah: Sample curl included by customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \n -d '{"model":"rwd-neo", "input":"...", "tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{...}}]}'
```
No 5xxs, just slow responses and many waiting in "schema-validate" span.

jamal: I'm seeing the same in traces — the validator hangs on some large nested schemas, sync code path. Majority of time spent in compile/validate (~2.6s in tail).

luis: On prod-metrics: toolcall QPS steady, but concurrency for validation workers at 100% and queue length ~60. Memory ok. Looks like a regression from async->sync switch in schema service in last rollout.

anya: Which release touched that? I thought we moved schema validation to a pooled async worker to reduce blocking.

jamal: We reverted an experiment two days ago (commit 9f3b) that changed validator to run inline for better determinism. That correlates with timeline.

maria: Customer ops wants a workaround ASAP. Can we route that customer to a fallback that skips validation?

jamal: Short-term mitigation options:
- Rollback commit 9f3b (fastest)
- Enable per-tenant config to skip strict schema validation (requires flag flip and small deploy)
- Increase validator worker pool and make validation call async with timeouts

sarah: Customer prefers a quick toggle rather than a full rollback. They can accept slightly laxer validation for now.

ops-bot: :gear: Deploy window available in 10m for hotfix channel.

jamal: Will prepare a hotfix to re-enable async validation with max 500ms CPU budget and fallback to best-effort parsing. I can land a patch to read per-request header x-skip-schema:true to bypass.

luis: Suggest also adding a short-circuit for small schemas (<6 fields) to use fast path, and instrument schema compile cache TTL to avoid cold compiles.

maria: Repro steps from support to validate patch:
1) Start local dev harness with prod schema bundle
2) Replay customer payloads via load test at 5 RPS with high concurrency
3) Confirm p99 under 800ms and no backlog in validation queue

jamal: Patch pushed to staging branch; adding feature-flag: schema.async=true by default. Will run smoke.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Staging smoke passed (10k calls, p99=420ms).

anya: OK, plan: 1) flip flag for customer XYZ 2) monitor 30m 3) if green, do org-wide flag flip and follow-up with a rollback-only revert in case issues.

maria: Noted. I'll tell customer ops: temporary toggle then scheduled org flip.

sarah: Thanks. Please post the rollout timeline and the commit/PR when ready.

jamal: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/validator/pulls/421 (will add PR link in thread). Landing in 8m to hotfix channel.

luis: Postmortem action items (for follow-up):
- Re-introduce integration test covering large nested schema performance
- Add schema compile cache metrics + alert when compile time >200ms per item
- Add opt-in per-tenant validation policy UI in Console

maria: Customer ops updated: toggle enabled for XYZ at 1759000200, customer reports latency normalizing. Will monitor. :thumbsup:

sarah: Great. Keep this thread updated with metrics.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert subscription created for /v1/toolcall p99 on customer xyz-914 (threshold 800ms)

jamal: Closing loop: rolling org-wide flip planned in 2 hours if no regressions.
